supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records do not show the alerted hundreds-of-MB outbound transfer itself or identify its external destination or originating process. Nearby Zeek records show FILE-HD-01 connections to the proxy with comparatively small recorded byte counts, but do not establish that they are the alerted transfer.

The environment names CobaltVault's FILE-HD-01 agent as a legitimate explanation for uploads of several hundred MB, but the available records do not link the alerted activity to that agent or service.

known_telemetry_limitations: Sensor coverage metadata reports that FILE-HD-01 winsec and Sysmon logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the alert window.
Sensor coverage metadata reports that PROXY-HD-01 proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the alert window.
Zeek connection records are available, but the nearby FILE-HD-01 records show connections to the proxy, not the proxy's downstream destination or a verified transfer of hundreds of MB.
claims_not_established: Whether the alerted transfer occurred as described, its precise start and end time, volume, and destination.
Whether CobaltVault's approved agent, another legitimate process, or an unauthorized process initiated the transfer.
Whether the transfer contained authorized backup data or data being exfiltrated.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs and byte counts for FILE-HD-01 activity during 13:20–14:20 UTC, including upstream destination, URL or service, and transfer volume.
Obtain CobaltVault agent and job logs for the alert window, and verify whether an upload matching the time and volume occurred.
Recover FILE-HD-01 process/network telemetry for the outage period, especially process attribution and any CobaltVault agent execution or configuration changes.
Correlate firewall or network-flow records for FILE-HD-01 and PROXY-HD-01 to establish the actual egress destination and bytes transferred.
unrelated_findings: PROXY-HD-01 initiated an SMB connection to FILE-HD-01 on port 445 at 13:39:43; this is an unexpected service/host relationship to review separately. (T010-00248, T010-00251)

FILE-HD-01 initiated an RPC connection to WS-OHADDAD-01 on port 135 at 14:05:34. This is opposite the stated IT practice that remote administration is performed from WS-OHADDAD-01; investigate separately. (T010-00528, T010-00529, T010-00530)
